text:
alex r: kicking off new model A->A.v2 incremental rollout. want to nail down gating heuristics before canary :eyes:
mira: +1. quick summary: v2 is int8 quantized with a small prompt-finetune. perf looks ok on bench but worried about regressions on long-context tests.
jorge: baseline numbers from local eval: latency p95 down 30%, token cost -40%, exact-match on QA dev set dropped 0.9%.
ealva: dropped <1% seems acceptable if other metrics hold, but we need service-level gates not just avg EM.
alex r: propose gates: 1) latency SLO p95 must not increase >5% vs prod 2) semantic QA pass rate (measured by embedding-similarity) must not drop >1.5% absolute 3) hallucination score (failing our safety eval) must not increase >0.5% 4) error rate / 5xxs <= 0.2%
mira: add automatic fallback thresholds: if any gate breaches for >5m during canary, route traffic back to A immediately; if breach is intermittent but repeats 3 times in 24h, block promotion.
jorge: for A/B we should require statistical significance: uplift/downgrade p-value < 0.05 using bootstrap on user queries; minimum N=2000 queries per arm.
ava: deploy-bot: starting canary at 1% traffic for 30 minutes, then 5% for 2 hours if green. will post monitoring links.
deploy-bot: Canary started: model=A.v2, split=1%, duration_target=30m, started_by=alex r
alex r: monitoring dashboards: https://console.redwood/models/A/v2/canary and perf panel: https://console.redwood/metrics/canary/1825501111
mira: for long context tests, run the L50/L100 suites (these are synthetic prompts we keep). If delta EM > 2% on those, immediate rollback.
jorge: packing in an extra rolling metric: token-level entropic drift. if top-token distribution KL divergence > 0.12 vs baseline across 1k samples, flag.
eva: wanted to propose a graceful fallback path: canary traffic should be able to hit an alternate variant: A.v2-fp16 (same weights, fp16 runtime) if quantized path shows instability. switch must be automated on latency or error gate.
mira: agree, config snippet we can use for rollout policy: ```
canary:
  steps:
    - percent: 1
      duration: 30m
    - percent: 5
      duration: 2h
  gates:
    latency_p95_delta_pct: 5
    semantic_drop_pct: 1.5
    error_rate_pct: 0.2
  fallback_order: ["A.v2-fp16","A.v1"]
  auto_rollback_violations: 1
  violation_window: 5m
```
alex r: who will own realtime alerts? mir a or eng-oncall?
mira: ops will own pager for error-rate/latency spikes, eng-ml gets slack alerts for quality gates (semantic/hallucination). I'll wire notifications to #eng-ml-canaries.
ejorge: also log every canary decision in audit trail with the metrics snapshot, so we can postmortem subtle regressions.
deploy-bot: Canary health check update (10m): latency p95 -2%, error_rate 0.05%, semantic_drop 0.6% — currently within gates
eva: nice. next step after 2h at 5% is to run 24h A/B for significance before promoting to dedicated or default routing.
alex r: thanks all — will let deploy run and check back at the 5% mark. if anyone wants to add more gates (BLEU/ROUGE for specific tasks) speak now.
mira: i'll add task-specific thresholds for summarization pipeline (ROUGE-L delta <=1.2) and for translation we'll use BLEU delta <=0.8.
alex r: perfect. closing channel for now, will update with final decision. :rocket:
